messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need to finalize the per-model/route SLO panels for Console (P50/P95/P99, TTFT, tokens/sec). Need inputs from runtime/infra/console on what metrics we actually can expose. Who can take inventory and call out gaps?

carlos: I can start. Current runtime exports: request_latency_seconds (histogram) with labels {model, route, model_variant, region, customer_tier}. We also emit tokens_emitted_total (counter) per request in streaming mode. TTFT is not emitted as a single metric right now.

rebecca: Cardinality warning — model_variant has ~120 values and customer_tier/org_id would blow up dashboards if we naively create per-tenant panels. Suggest default panels aggregate by model+route and expose label filters for drilldown. Also we should agree on derived metrics rather than raw per-variant panels.

carlos: Agree. Example PromQL snippets we currently use for generic panels:```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, route))
rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m])
```

jonathan: Note on tokens/sec for streaming: tokens_emitted_total is incremented as tokens arrive, so tokens/sec should be computed with rate(). For TTFT, if we can't emit a single metric we should add a gauge first_token_latency_seconds that records time-to-first-token per request on completion. Then TTFT P95 = histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(first_token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, route)).

sam: Console/UX notes: Default dashboard for a model route should show: P50/P95/P99 latency, TTFT P50/P95, tokens/sec (1m/5m), and request throughput (rps). Drilldown options: model_variant, region, and timeframe. For rollouts we need a side-by-side comparison vs baseline (previous deployment) and a highlight if any P95 regresses >10%. Keep panels compact for mobile view.

kai: Quick infra heads-up — histograms at full cardinality are expensive. We're currently sampling 10% of requests for full percentile telemetry to save ingest costs. If we need full fidelity at per-variant granularity we'll need budget approval or to use exemplars/traces for P99 only. Otherwise we can provide accurate P50/P95 with sampled histograms and approximate P99 via summary metrics.

olivia: From product: enterprise customers will ask for tenant-scoped SLO panels and alerting. Can we support tenant-level panels as opt-in for dedicated/private customers? Also need the ability to export CSVs of the panel data for compliance reports.

carlos: We can emit org_id label but only for dedicated/private and opt-in for hosted (privacy). We'll gate org_id emission behind a config flag; runtime PR will add first_token_latency_seconds and ensure tokens_emitted_total is emitted reliably for both streaming and non-streaming paths.

rebecca: Platform needs clarity on retention windows and downsampling policy so Console can decide default time ranges and aggregation (e.g., 1h rollup at 30d). Kai, can you document sampling and retention?

kai: Will do. Current plan: 30d raw (sampled), 90d 1m rollups, 365d 5m rollups. Sampling: 10% full histogram, 100% counters. Cost delta estimate in next 48h.

jonathan: Also callout: tokens/sec calculation for streaming should be: rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m]) grouped by model/route — avoid dividing by request_duration_seconds for streamed responses since duration is not stable. Example:```promql
sum by (model,route) (rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m]))
```

sam: Actionable UX tasks: I'll draft two Console wireframes — (1) default model-route overview panel with aggregate metrics, (2) drilldown/variant view. Also add an opt-in tenant toggle in settings. Will post sketches by EOD tomorrow.

maya: Action items recap: 1) runtime (carlos) -> add first_token_latency_seconds gauge + ensure tokens_emitted_total emitted per request; 2) infra (kai) -> document sampling/retention and cost delta; 3) platform (rebecca/sam) -> draft dashboard panel contracts and drilldown behavior; 4) ml (jonathan) -> confirm tokens/sec formula and provide PromQL examples; 5) product (olivia) -> list enterprise requirements for tenant panels/export. Please reply with ETA.

deploy-bot: telemetry-service: merged runtime/telemetry PR #432 by carlos — added first_token_latency_seconds metric and tokens_emitted_total consistency fix. (deployed to staging)

maya: Thanks — I'll collate timelines and set a follow-up sync for tomorrow 10:30am PT. If anyone has blockers reply here or ping me directly.
